headline: Profit surges, guidance trimmed on soft demand
summary_short: NCLH posted Q2 FY2026 GAAP EPS of $0.48 (vs. $0.07 a year ago) on revenue of $2.64B, up 4.9% y/y, as Adjusted EBITDA of $666M topped the company's own guidance of $632M despite falling 4.1% y/y.
summary_long: Revenue grew 4.9% y/y to $2.64B on higher Capacity Days, while GAAP net income rose to $223M ($0.48 EPS) from $30M ($0.07) a year earlier, aided by a currency-driven swing in other income and lower net interest expense. Adjusted EBITDA fell 4.1% y/y to $666M but beat the company's own guidance of $632M, and Adjusted EPS of $0.48 beat its $0.38 guide. Net Yield fell 2.1% y/y, better than the guided 3.6% decline. Citing execution challenges pressuring demand generation, NCLH updated full-year 2026 guidance to ~$2.5B Adjusted EBITDA and ~$1.50 Adjusted EPS. Cash stood at $218M against $15.0B total debt (5.3x net leverage).

drivers.explanation: Revenue growth was driven by increased Capacity Days.
Net income growth reflects revenue growth plus a swing in other income (+$34M vs -$156M) and lower net interest expense (-$171M vs -$237M) versus the prior-year quarter.
Operating income fell y/y as cruise operating expense (+8.9%) and other operating expense (+8.4%) grew faster than revenue (+4.9%).
Citing execution challenges pressuring demand generation and revenue outlook, the company updated full-year 2026 guidance, even as Q2 results themselves beat its own Adjusted EBITDA and EPS guidance.
